t: Mordax DATA favorable buying at our shop | USA
s: The Mordax DATA is a multi-tool utility module that is compatible for Eurorack modular synthesizers. It features a 4-channel oscilloscope, tuner, voltage monitor & source, waveform generator, clock tool, spectral analyzer and a spectrograph. The oscilloscope can be used to monitor four CV or audio channels independently.
